_comment: 5.2 golden baseline for tools/audit_render_probe.py metrics, encoding audit §11 DoD #7-#12. Bounds are the pass criteria; the live regression test renders the probe PDF and asserts every metric falls inside. Regenerate ONLY by re-measuring a known-good render, never by editing to fit a broken one (same rule as test_page_budget). W-09 (2026-08-01): telemetry boundary — technical appendix moved to operator artifact, glance confidence cell removed. Bounds re-measured against the new contract, not widened.

page_count.note: Re-measured 2026-08-01 from a known-good render (blank_pages 0, all four leak counters 0, chars/line 54, 2 column bands, 7 exhibits). 36 -> 42: the probe had been raising AttributeError on the technical-appendix builder W-09 deleted, so this bound had not been re-measured since W-05/W-08/W-09/P2-* landed and W-10 added the six-subsection methodology (pages 35-37). Composition: 1 cover + 1 at-a-glance + 1 TOC + 2 executive summary + 28 body (7 sections x 4 sheets) + 1 risk analysis + 3 methodology + 1 endnotes + 3 source appendix + 1 colophon.

embedded_images.note: 300-DPI charts, one per section; section imagery (DoD #12, >=2000px) is not exercised by the probe payload (section_images=None) and is covered by test_font_embedding/test imagery checks

glance_labels_present.note: W-09: at-a-glance Confidence cell removed as internal telemetry; RECOMMENDATION / EVIDENCE BASE / ANALYSIS DEPTH remain

technical_appendix_sections.note: W-09: technical appendix is operator telemetry (reports/diagnostics/), not a client page; any appendix section in the client PDF is now a defect counted DOWN to zero
